canonical_origin.workspace: website/ (Next.js app, deployed as the `website` service on :3005)
canonical_origin.ownership: BANZA protocol repo; demo-only reference simulator; NOT a real/published operator; never in /operators; no CA/certification (post-M2.19A open trust)

deploy.reverse_proxy: infra/banza-network/nginx/conf.d/banza.conf → server_name zero.banza.network (443) → proxy_pass http://website:3005 with Host preserved (NO routing logic in nginx; BanzAI never proxied here)
deploy.cloudflare: proxied DNS record `zero`, SSL Full (strict), CloudFlare Origin CA cert SAN *.banza.network

rules: zero host `/` → rewrite to internal /oz (the standalone lab)
zero host `/banzai*` → 307 redirect to https://banza.network/banzai (BanzAI stays on apex)
/operador-zero and /operador-zero/* → 410 Gone on EVERY host (retired apex surface, M2.12G)
/oz, /oz/* on the apex → 404 (internal name, never public)

app_component_tree.shell: website/app/oz/page.tsx (chromeless: own header/footer, suppresses SiteNav/SiteFooter; NAV badges + BanzAI/Reference/GitHub links)
app_component_tree.artifact_api: website/app/oz/[...artifact]/route.ts (force-static GET handler for the 10 demo JSON endpoints; POST/PUT/PATCH/DELETE → 405)

engine_and_libs.rust_engine: engines/operator-zero-core/ (src/sim.rs, ledger.rs, boundary.rs, vocab.rs) — Rust authority for ledger/payment/refund/reconciliation/trust/federation/evidence/traces (ADR-037)
adapters: website/lib/operadorZeroEngine.ts (runOperadorZeroE2E, identity, boundary, safeSummary — WASM I/O glue)
website/lib/operadorZero.ts (10 ARTIFACT_ROUTES, readArtifact, VALIDATION_STATE, identity constants)
website/lib/operadorZeroJourney.ts (BanzAI journey step model, STEP_FILES, unlock gating)

data_state.database: NONE — no PostgreSQL, no server state, no per-visitor storage
data_state.served_bytes: bundled constants from lib/operadorZeroArtifacts.generated.ts (website image is built from website/ alone; examples/ tree absent at runtime)
data_state.canonical_source_tree: examples/operators/zero/ (52 files; validated by the Rust engine; vendored to the website by tools/gen-operador-zero-artifacts.mjs)

simulation_entrypoints.what: Hero "Iniciar simulação" button → run(true) → runOperadorZeroE2E — executes the full E2E simulation
run() callback invoking runOperadorZeroE2E(happy) — the client-side WASM simulation driver + trace/score state
Fictional QR payment (1500 KZ_DEMO) + partial refund (500) simulation surface (Ana→Kiosque), driven by the run
Fictional ledger + reconciliation re-derivation display fed by the live run (balances, total conservation)
Interactive 9-step journey (Manifest/Conformidade/Trust/Pagamento/Reembolso/Reconciliação/Federação/EvidenceBundle/Traces) whose verdicts come from the run
11 negative-case triggers producing blockers (secret leak, revoked, incompatible federation, etc.)
evidenceScore()/artifactsReady() computing a live 0..100 evidence score + '6/6 artefactos' from the run (evidence generation)
CTA → banza.network/banzai?template=operador-zero&clone=1 (clone the simulator into a BanzAI session and run the journey)
runOperadorZeroE2E / operadorZeroBoundary / operadorZeroSafeSummary — the client execution surface over the WASM engine
Vendored WASM build of engines/operator-zero-core that performs the in-browser simulation
Session-clone evidence + step-unlock gating that turn the Zero template into a runnable journey
Consumes ?template=operador-zero → startZeroSession() (apex; runs the cloned Zero journey inside BanzAI)

routes: Simulation-driving parts of website/app/oz/page.tsx (keep a chromeless read-only shell; drop the interactive lab mount)
website/app/oz/[...artifact]/route.ts — KEEP (already read-only GET; already refuses writes with 405) — repurpose as the read-only reference API

BanzAI clone/journey UI in website/components/banzai/BanzaiAgent.tsx (template=operador-zero session start + per-step run/clone panels)
handlers_state: run()/reset() callbacks + trace/scenario/score React state in OperadorZeroLab.tsx
startZeroSession/clearZero + journey report state in BanzaiAgent.tsx
mocks_data: Negative/execution-only fixtures surfaced by the lab (examples/operators/zero: *.invalid*.json, *fail*.json, *revoked*.json, demo-failed-payment.json, failed-e2e-trace.json, evidence-bundle.partial/invalid.json, federation-incompatible.json, trust-fail-closed/revoked.json) — keep only what a read-only reference must expose
docs: Reference chapter 09 'operador-zero' interactive-experience copy (website/lib/reference.ts:85 + content) — retune from 'watch one work' to read-only reference
nav: website/lib/site.ts:56 footer link 'Operador Zero' → https://zero.banza.network/ (repoint to the read-only reference, keep neutrality controls)
website/components/home/OperatorRegistry.tsx:18 FALLBACK card → zero.banza.network (marquee entry that presents Zero as a live surface)
OperadorZeroLab NAV_LINks / BanzAI-section CTAs in app/oz/page.tsx + OperadorZeroLab.tsx

read_only_surface_present: 10 machine-readable GET JSON endpoints on zero.banza.network via app/oz/[...artifact]/route.ts (GET 200 / write 405 / unknown 404, cache 300s, force-static): manifest, key-manifest, revocation-list, conformance/evidence, federation/metadata, evidence-bundle, traces/full-e2e, ledger/demo, payments/demo-qr, payments/demo-refund

Identity + environment: /manifest.json → operator_id=operator-zero, operator_display_name, environment=sandbox, protocol_version=1.0.0, manifest_version=1, created_at, operator_status=READY_FOR_SIMB_PRE_REVIEW, currency=KZ_DEMO
Public keys: /key-manifest.json (delegated demo signing keys) + Demo Operator Root (demo-operator-root.public.json in canonical tree)
Demo/boundary flags exposed in-page: demo_only, monetary_value=false, production_allowed=false, real_money=false, certification=false, operator_real=false, currency=KZ_DEMO
Contact: manifest.contact → GitHub issues; canonical artifacts link → examples/operators/zero on GitHub
read_only_surface_missing: /health — no liveness/health endpoint on the subdomain
/version(s) — no dedicated version endpoint (protocol_version lives only inside manifest; no engine/build/spec version triple)
/schemas — no machine-readable JSON Schemas for the artifact types (only Rust ARTIFACT_TYPE vocabulary internally)
metadata_hash / integrity digest — no top-level content hash of the manifest/bundle for deterministic verification
verification URLs / instructions — no machine field pointing at how to reproduce/verify locally (deterministic-local)
endpoint index / .well-known catalog — no /index.json or /.well-known listing of all endpoints (only the UI ARTIFACT_ROUTES + manifest.endpoints)
trust state endpoint — key-manifest + revocation-list are served, but no served current trust-evaluation result (trust-pass/trust-revoked exist only in examples/ tree)

certification/validation state as a served route — status/operator-zero-validation-state.json is bundled into the UI (OPERADOR_ZERO_VALIDATION_STATE) but is NOT in ZERO_ENDPOINTS (not fetchable as JSON)
interoperability certification state — federation/metadata is served, but no explicit technical-interop-cert state (aligns with M2.19 ADR-DRAFT-technical-interoperability-certification)
signed evidence refs — examples/operators/zero/e2e-root/*signed* (signed manifest/bundle/verification-trace/fingerprint) are NOT served on the subdomain
identity/capabilities as a standalone endpoint — only embedded in manifest, not a discrete /identity or /capabilities route
explicit read-only technical-test endpoints for BanzAI-initiated verification (a stable GET contract BanzAI can fetch to run deterministic checks)
